title_en: Maintenance for Wife, Children & Parents: Section 144 BNSS & Senior Citizens Act 2007
title_hi: पत्नी, बच्चों और माता-पिता का भरण-पोषण: धारा 144 बीएनएसएस एवं वरिष्ठ नागरिक भरण-पोषण कानून 2007
keywords_en: Maintenance of Parents and Senior Citizens Act 2007
warrant for non payment of maintenance

laws.plain_meaning: Order for maintenance of wives, children and parents: If any person having sufficient means neglects or refuses to maintain his wife (unable to maintain herself), legitimate/illegitimate minor child, or father/mother unable to maintain himself/herself, a Magistrate of the first class may order monthly allowance. Application for interim maintenance must be disposed of within 60 days of service of notice.

If any person fails without sufficient cause to comply with the maintenance order, Magistrate may issue a warrant for levying the amount due like a fine, and sentence the defaulter to imprisonment for up to one month for each month's allowance remaining unpaid.

laws.act: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007
laws.plain_meaning: Senior citizens/parents unable to maintain themselves can apply before the Maintenance Tribunal (headed by Sub-Divisional Officer / SDO) against children or legal heirs. Section 9 provides monthly allowance; Section 23 provides that transfer of property by senior citizen subject to condition of providing basic amenities can be declared void by Tribunal if children fail to maintain.

Uniform guidelines across all maintenance laws: mandatory filing of comprehensive Affidavit of Assets and Liabilities by both parties; maintenance orders to take effect from the date of filing of application; simultaneous orders under different laws can be adjusted.

steps.action_en: Choose the appropriate legal forum: Wives and children apply under Section 144 BNSS in Family Court / JMFC court (or PWDVA s.20). Senior citizens/parents can choose either Section 144 BNSS or the speedier summary Maintenance Tribunal (SDO Office) under the Senior Citizens Act 2007.
steps.action_hi: उचित अदालत का चयन करें: पत्नी व बच्चे परिवार न्यायालय / सीजेएम कोर्ट में धारा 144 BNSS के तहत आवेदन करें। माता-पिता एसडीओ न्यायालय में वरिष्ठ नागरिक कानून के तहत त्वरित आवेदन दे सकते हैं।
steps.where: Family Court / JMFC Court (for wife/children) or Maintenance Tribunal / SDO Office (for senior citizens)
steps.deadline_or_limitation: Application can be filed at any time while neglect continues; recovery of arrears must be filed within 1 year of falling due
documents_needed: Proof of relationship (Marriage certificate / Ration card / Birth certificate / Photos)
Proof of respondent's income and employment

steps.action_en: Draft the petition with a specific prayer for Interim Maintenance under the proviso to Section 144(1) BNSS. File the mandatory Affidavit of Assets and Liabilities in accordance with the Supreme Court format in Rajnesh v. Neha.
steps.action_hi: याचिका में अंतरिम भरण-पोषण की विशेष मांग करें। दोनों पक्षों को सुप्रीम कोर्ट के रजनेश बनाम नेहा प्रारूप में परिसंपत्ति व देनदारी का शपथपत्र दाखिल करना अनिवार्य है।
steps.deadline_or_limitation: Statute mandates disposal of interim application within 60 days of notice
documents_needed: Comprehensive Affidavit of Assets and Liabilities (ITRs, salary slips, bank statements, expenses)
Interim maintenance application under s.144(1) proviso

steps.action_en: For elderly parents whose children took property and neglected them, file an application before the Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) under Section 23 of the Senior Citizens Act to cancel the gift deed / transfer of property.
steps.action_hi: यदि बच्चों ने सेवा के नाम पर जमीन-जायदाद लिखवा ली और फिर छोड़ दिया, तो धारा 23 के तहत एसडीओ ट्रिब्यूनल में रजिस्ट्री रद्द करने का आवेदन लगाएं।
steps.deadline_or_limitation: Within reasonable time of breach of condition
documents_needed: Application in prescribed format under Senior Citizens Rules
Copy of registered Gift Deed or Settlement Deed
Proof of lack of medical/food support

steps.action_en: If respondent fails to pay ordered maintenance, file an enforcement execution application under Section 144(3) BNSS. The court will issue salary attachment, distress warrant for property attachment, or non-bailable warrant committing defaulter to jail.
steps.action_hi: आदेश के बाद भी पति/पुत्र द्वारा खर्चा न देने पर धारा 144(3) BNSS के तहत वसूली अर्जी (एक्जीक्यूशन) लगाएं। अदालत वेतन अटैच करने या जेल भेजने का वारंट जारी करती है।
steps.deadline_or_limitation: Application for warrant must be made within 1 year from the date on which amount became due
documents_needed: Arrears calculation chart with dates and bank statement

helplines.description: For wives seeking emergency support and maintenance guidance

free_legal_aid.eligible: All women, minor children, senior citizens, and persons unable to maintain themselves qualify for free legal representation under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987.
free_legal_aid.how_to_apply: Approach the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) in the District Court or SDO office. A legal aid lawyer will be appointed without any fee to draft the Section 144 BNSS or Senior Citizens Act petition.

when_to_see_a_lawyer: To accurately draft the Affidavit of Assets and Liabilities to unearth concealed business income or hidden properties of the spouse
To execute arrears recovery warrants under Section 144(3) BNSS within the 1-year limitation window
For drafting petitions under Section 23 of the Senior Citizens Act to revoke property gift deeds
